normalizedOutcome: A topology-critic receipt can only be signed from a session whose identity the host derived, so an implementer who also holds the owner lease and dispatches the reviewer can no longer supply the identity that reviewer signs under. Option 1 of three presented alternatives (host injects dispatch provenance) rather than option 2 (open the dispatch command to the critic role) or option 3 (re-key the independence binding).
acceptanceClaim: topology_critic_receipt_set refuses a session sourced from LATTICE_SESSION_ID with an error naming the received source, while a genuinely dispatched critic whose session the host derived still signs request_changes successfully.
